text:
Key decisions
- Job key = project+prompt+engine+day+run:
  retries never double count
- Keep raw answers: re-parse when
  the parser improves
- One queue + rate limit per engine;
  breaker when a provider is down
- Same prompt+engine+region+day
  across tenants = run once, share
- Postgres for config, ClickHouse
  for millions of facts
